palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed purple and yellow cap, pale body, magenta limbs, brown soles, source eyes and black outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr607 mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded with fixed row-47 shadow. Preserve source lift and recoil; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own alternating boot-and-arm step cycle; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward arm-and-boot strike with full recovery; Physical Attack remains untrimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own two-hand gather and release gesture; no invented projectile or glow.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own lowered cap-and-head resting loop; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary backward recoil. Extreme upside-down bd02/bd03 knockdowns remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own broad alternate arm-and-leg sweep. Native bs01 exits the stationary frame and is rejected; no synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the own strike; one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouch, airborne boot-forward apex, and landing; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own raised-arm braced charge with reverse-sampled recovery; no aura.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready stance with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
